title: Enterprise Agent Platform — Tenants
description: Per-tenant breakdown: config/tenants/*.yaml defines payment-disputes (CC-PAYMENTS-DISPUTES), complaints-triage (CC-COMPLAINTS-TRIAGE), and kyc-review (CC-KYC-REVIEW). Every panel here is grouped by the tenant label so one tenant's load or spend is never folded into another's; there is no unlabelled series in this platform's metrics.
